services.desc: There is no question that New Orleans is the ultimate Bachelor Party location; and is there a better bachelor party activity than a fishing trip with your buddies just 35 minutes from the French Quarter? We doubt it! At Griffin Fishing, we know how important that final send-off is, and we’ve put together the perfect experience that’s been tailored “for the boys”. If you’re the best man or are helping to plan a memorable event for your soon-to-be-married buddy, a New Orleans fishing bachelor party is the right choice for an unforgettable time. blurb: Guests fish for Louisiana Redfish and other species inshore in marshes and bayous near Barataria, Louisiana. The experience includes guided fishing charters with professional USCG licensed guides, lodging in private suites, and Cajun meals. The lodge is waterfront and located about 35 minutes south of New Orleans.

quotes.author: Griffin
quotes.text: Griffin Fishing Charters is the best, We went with a group of friends this past weekend… The service was exceptional, rooms were nicely appointed, all meals; including breakfast, lunch and dinner were all chef prepared. The fishing guides were all very knowledgeable and I have to say some of the nicest people, they made us feel like family. Our guide made the trip memorable, he was born to fish! I would definitely recommend Griffin Fishing Charters, we are excited for our next visit.

quotes.author: This
quotes.text: This was the best charter fishing trip I have ever taken. Our guide was amazing, he is a local and knew exactly where to go and which bait to fish with. The facilities are above and beyond, way better than any fishing camp I have ever been to. The food and the dining area were fantastic. I can imagine out-of-towners will love the Louisiana Cajun food. We plan on making this an annual event. Great to all the folks at Griffin Fishing Charters and Lodge.

quotes.author: I
quotes.text: I cannot possibly say enough good things about this place. Service was exceptional, but not overbearing at all. Hospitality was out of this world. I am a rookie at fishing, don’t even own a pole, but with the help of our guide I felt like a pro in no time. This team has got it together! Fantastic accommodations, huge rooms! Food was stellar! I will be back very soon!

quotes.author: What
quotes.text: What a great lodge and a great experience!! Everyone and everything at Griffin’s made us feel at home. The fishing was great. The guides were excellent. The food was fantastic. Our lodging could not have been any cleaner and updated. But, most importantly, the people were great. Thank you for a wonderful weekend. We will be back.

Best outfitter in the region. Lodging is incredibly clean and well appointed. All guides are engaging and really ensure a top-tier guest experience. We’ve brought groups from bachelor parties to corporate clients and everyone always says it’s the best fishing charter they’ve ever experienced!

quotes.author: What
quotes.text: What a great time! Lodge was clean, all the food was amazing! Nice job on putting together a complete package. Can’t give our guide enough credit- Great guide, great spots, great teacher- knows how to fish, when and where. It’s like fishing with your Buddy- only he is way better!
